visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black t-shirt and blue shorts and a young girl in pink pajamas sit on a grey couch in a bright living room; they wave and gesture at the camera while a French Bulldog sits on the floor. (2) The man lies on the couch and performs chest presses using the little girl as a weight, lifting her toward the ceiling and back down. (3) The man sits on the couch and performs overhead shoulder presses by lifting the girl vertically above his head. (4) The man stands up in the center of the room and performs front deltoid raises by lifting the girl straight out in front of him, making exaggerated effortful facial expressions. (5) The man performs deadlifts and core stabilization movements by lifting the girl from the floor and holding her horizontally at waist level. (6) The man places the girl on his back and performs several deep squats while holding her legs for stability. (7) The man and girl return to sitting on the couch; the man drinks from a grey protein shaker bottle while the girl eats from a small pink bowl, and they look toward the camera.
